summary: Release publication treats GitHub HTTP/2 errors of the form stream error: stream ID N; CANCEL; received from peer as transient. They use the existing bounded retry and reconciliation path, so a create that already made a draft is resumed rather than repeated. Partial drafts are still continued and published assets are never replaced.

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Release scripts only; no product binary, claim or wire change.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores the previous transient-error classification.
